designVerdict: REJECTED - evaluated against C2890041 and not chosen.
notes: SK6812-EC20, 2 x 2 mm top-view. Its VIH of 0.6 x VDD is the most permissive of the three variants evaluated, which raised the question of whether the 74AHCT541 could be deleted - it cannot. 0.6 x 5.0 V = 3.0 V against the ESP32-C6's guaranteed V_OH of 0.8 x VDD = 2.64 V. No SK6812 in this family can be driven directly.
Rejected in favour of the side-emitting C2890041, which suits an enclosure better. Area is comparable (4.0 mm2 against 3.52) and price nearly identical.
